blogs.title: Revolutionizing Indian Roads: Vayve Mobility Unveils Eva - The Solar-Powered Game-Changer
blogs.subtitle: Discover Eva, India's first solar-powered electric car by Vayve Mobility. With a 250 km range and solar roof, it redefines sustainable urban commut...
blogs.author: Prashant
blogs.description: Discover Eva, India's first solar-powered electric car by Vayve Mobility. With a 250 km range and solar roof, it redefines sustainable urban commuting. Unveiled at Bharat Mobility Expo 2025.
blogs.content: Leading the Charge in Sustainable Urban MobilityVayve Mobility has taken up the challenge of reshaping India’s urban mobility by making it cleaner and more sustainable than ever imagined. And here by “cleaner and more sustainable,” we are not talking only about EVs, but by using the renewable energy as the main source to power up your ride. Vayve Mobility, a Pune-based startup, is all set to introduced 'Eva,' India's first solar-powered electric car, at the Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2025. The launch of this one-of-the-kind vehicle marks a statement about the future of transportation in one of the world's fastest-growing economies. So, what exactly does Vayve Mobility claims to offer? What will be Eva’s role in the Indian EV market? Lets take a comprehensive look.Understanding Vayve MobilityFounded in 2021, Vayve Mobility set out with a mission to design vehicles that would transform urban commuting. With a vision for sustainable, efficient, and affordable mobility, Vayve seems to have potential to quickly become a name to watch in the electric vehicle (EV) sector. Although, the company has already presented their Eva concept in Auto Expo 2023, the showcase in Bharat Mobility Expo will mark the company’s new achievements of achieving a close-to-production prototype. Well you know what is the saying? Good things take time! Showcasing the Future of Urban at Bharat Mobility Expo 2025The Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2025 played a pivotal role in Eva's introduction to the public. Held from January 17 to 22 in New Delhi, this event became the stage where Eva transitioned from a concept to a near-production reality. The expo, known for showcasing the latest in automotive innovation, provided Vayve Mobility with unparalleled visibility, attracting not only potential buyers but also investors and industry experts. Eva's display at Bharat Mobility underscored the growing interest in sustainable transport solutions in India, contributing significantly to its buzz.Eva - A Solar-Powered Revolution in Urban Transportation: Eva stands out with its solar-powered roof, offering an additional 10 km of range daily from sunlight alone, combined with a 250 km range on a single charge. This dual power system, alongside its compact design tailored for city life, positions Eva as a pioneer in eco-friendly urban transport.Catering to the Needs of Urban Commuters: Eva is primarily aimed at urban dwellers in India, particularly those who commute short distances daily. It's an ideal second car for families, focusing on cost efficiency, easy parking, and minimal environmental impact.Competition: In the burgeoning Indian EV market, Vayve faces competition from giants like Tata Motors and Mahindra, but Eva's specific focus on solar energy and urban utility carves out a niche. Competitors offer EVs but lack the solar integration, which is Eva's forte.Detailed Highlights of EvaA Fusion of Form and Function: Eva's design philosophy is centered around urban practicality, featuring a compact, two-seater layout with a sleek, aerodynamic body. Its solar panels are integrated into the roof, maintaining a clean, modern aesthetic while enhancing functionality.Advanced Technology for a Seamless Driving Experience: In addition to solar powered features, Eva includes dual digital displays, fast-charging capabilities (adding 50 km in 5 minutes), and smart connectivity options. The vehicle supports OTA updates, ensuring it stays current with technology advancements.Powering Urban Journeys with Efficiency: With a 14 kWh battery and an electric motor producing 8.15 PS and 40 Nm, Eva is designed for city speeds, reaching from 0 to 40 kmph in 5 seconds with a top speed of 70 kmph. Its lightweight construction further enhances efficiency, reducing operational costs to about ₹0.5 per km.Driving Towards a Greener Future: Eva's environmental impact is profound, harnessing solar energy to reduce reliance on grid electricity and fossil fuels. This aligns with India's sustainability goals, making it a symbol of green mobility.Company Vision & Future PlansVayve Mobility aims to expand its footprint beyond Eva, targeting markets in South-East Asia, the Middle East, Africa, and South America. The company plans to vertically integrate by bringing battery pack technology and motor control in-house by 2025, ensuring control over product development and quality.The Impact of Eva on the EV MarketEva's introduction could significantly alter consumer perceptions of electric vehicles in India. Generally the argument given by the anti-EV promoters is that the electricity used to charge EVs is coming from burning thermal plants i.e. coal. Despite being loose on facts, with the introduction of the solar powered cars, this argument will loose the little merit it had.  By offering a car that tackles both urban mobility and environmental concerns, it could accelerate the shift from traditional vehicles to EVs, particularly in urban settings where space is at a premium.Welcome the changeVayve Mobility's Eva is more than a car; it's a vision of sustainable urban living. Its launch at the Bharat Mobility Expo 2025 marks a milestone in India's journey towards cleaner transport solutions. With its unique blend of solar-powered efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and urban design, Eva is well-positioned to play a crucial role in shaping the future of electric mobility in India.

blogs.title: OPG Mobility to unveil Groundbreaking EV Lineup at Bharat EV Expo 2025
blogs.subtitle: Discover how Okaya EV has transformed into OPG Mobility, unveiling a revolutionary lineup of electric vehicles at Bharat EV Expo 2025.
blogs.author: Prashant
blogs.description: Discover how Okaya EV has transformed into OPG Mobility, unveiling a revolutionary lineup of electric vehicles at Bharat EV Expo 2025.
blogs.content: The Bharat EV Expo 2025 marked a pivotal moment for the Indian electric vehicle (EV) sector as Okaya EV, a prominent manufacturer of electric two-wheelers, announced its rebranding to OPG Mobility. This strategic shift signifies a new era for the brand, with plans to strengthen its market position through an improved product range, innovative technology, and a stronger commitment to sustainability.Rebranding to OPG MobilityThe rebranding of Okaya EV to OPG Mobility signifies more than just a new name. It represents a strategic initiative to align the company’s identity with its future vision. OPG Mobility embodies a progressive and dynamic approach to the fast-changing EV market. During the event, the company’s CEO, Anshul Gupta, stated, “This rebranding showcases our dedication to innovation, customer satisfaction, and environmental responsibility. OPG Mobility is not merely a brand; it’s a movement towards a greener and smarter India.”This decision to rebrand comes at a pivotal moment as India’s EV sector experiences rapid growth, driven by government incentives, heightened environmental awareness, and increasing fuel costs. By embracing a new identity, OPG Mobility aims to set itself apart in a competitive landscape and attract a wider audience, particularly millennials and Gen Z, who are essential to the EV revolution.Highlights of Okaya (OPG Mobility) at the Bharat EV Expo 2025At the Bharat EV Expo, OPG Mobility showcased its revamped portfolio of electric two-wheelers, which includes both updated models and entirely new launches. These vehicles are designed to cater to a wide range of consumers, from daily commuters to eco-conscious enthusiasts. The spotlight was on three key models:OPG Feather: A sleek, lightweight electric scooter tailored for urban commuters. With a top speed of 60 km/h and a range of up to 120 kilometers per charge, the Feather promises efficiency without compromising on style.OPG Blaze: A high-performance electric motorcycle aimed at young riders. With its sporty design and advanced battery technology, the Blaze offers a range of 150 kilometers and a rapid charging feature that charges the battery to 80% in just 45 minutes.OPG Cargo: An electric three-wheeler designed for last-mile delivery. The Cargo’s robust build and impressive payload capacity make it an ideal choice for e-commerce and logistics companies looking to reduce their carbon footprint.Commitment to Innovation and SustainabilityOne of the key announcements at the expo was OPG Mobility’s investment in advanced battery technology. The company revealed plans to establish a state-of-the-art battery manufacturing facility in Rajasthan, aimed at reducing dependency on imports and ensuring the availability of high-quality, indigenous batteries.In addition, OPG Mobility introduced its proprietary battery-swapping technology, which allows users to exchange depleted batteries for fully charged ones within minutes. This initiative is expected to address the challenges of range anxiety and charging infrastructure, making EV ownership more convenient and accessible.“Our focus is on delivering value through innovation,” said Anshul Gupta. “With our cutting-edge battery solutions and smart features, OPG Mobility is poised to become a leader in the EV ecosystem.”A Legacy of ExcellenceOPG Mobility’s rebranding builds on the solid foundation laid by Okaya EV. Over the years, the company has earned a reputation for reliability, affordability, and customer-centricity. The transition to OPG Mobility is seen as a natural progression, reflecting the brand’s aspiration to expand its horizons and embrace the challenges of a dynamic industry.The company’s past milestones, including its entry into the EV market in 2016 and the subsequent launch of popular models like the Freedum and ClassIQ, have been instrumental in shaping its journey. With the rebranding, OPG Mobility aims to leverage its legacy while charting a new course towards innovation and global competitiveness.Industry Impact and Future PlansThe unveiling of OPG Mobility at the Bharat EV Expo 2025 underscores the company’s intent to play a pivotal role in India’s transition to electric mobility. The government’s ambitious target of achieving 30% EV penetration by 2030 provides a conducive environment for growth, and OPG Mobility is well-positioned to capitalize on this opportunity.Looking ahead, the company plans to expand its dealership network to over 1,000 outlets across India by 2026. It also intends to collaborate with tech startups to integrate artificial intelligence and IoT-enabled features into its vehicles, offering a smarter and more connected riding experience.OPG Mobility’s export strategy was another highlight of the event. The company announced plans to enter international markets, starting with Southeast Asia and Africa, where the demand for affordable and efficient EVs is on the rise.Customer-Centric ApproachTo further strengthen its bond with customers, OPG Mobility has launched a dedicated mobile app that provides real-time updates on battery status, nearby charging stations, and service reminders. The app also includes a loyalty program that rewards users for eco-friendly practices such as recycling batteries and promoting EV adoption.“Our customers are at the heart of everything we do,” said Gupta. “Through our app and other initiatives, we aim to build a community of environmentally conscious individuals who share our vision for a sustainable future.”ConclusionThe rebranding of Okaya EV to OPG Mobility and the impressive product showcase at the Bharat EV Expo 2025 signify a transformative moment for the brand. With its renewed identity, innovative offerings, and unwavering commitment to sustainability, OPG Mobility is set to redefine electric mobility in India and beyond.As the EV industry gears up for a promising future, OPG Mobility’s bold vision and strategic initiatives serve as a testament to the brand’s determination to lead the charge towards a greener tomorrow. The Bharat EV Expo 2025 will undoubtedly be remembered as the stage where OPG Mobility’s journey into a new era began.

blogs.title: BluSmart-backed Gensol EV presents EZIO at Global Expo 2025: Here are anticipated market changes
blogs.subtitle: Discover EZIO, Gensol EV's first electric vehicle debuting at Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2025. A game-changer in urban mobility, featuring zero-de...
blogs.author: Prashant
blogs.description: Discover EZIO, Gensol EV's first electric vehicle debuting at Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2025. A game-changer in urban mobility, featuring zero-defect manufacturing, cutting-edge technology, and sustainable innovation.
blogs.content: Have you ever heard of 'Zero Defect Workstations'? An EV manufacturing workstation where the top and field-level employees actively engage to deliver a product with 'zero' defects whatsoever. An EV developed with zero defects seems promising, right? Well, Gensol EV, a subsidiary of Gensol Engineering has turned this idea into reality. The company’s first EV– EZIO is going to be launched at the Bharat Mobility Global Expo 2025. The BluSmart-backed Gensol EV is expected to cater to the company’s cab service available in cities like Delhi, Bengaluru, and Mumbai(recently). Following the launch of EZIO, the EV subsidiary of Gensol along with the existing cab service, the parent company will now have greater autonomy. This partnership is forged on the foundation of shared values and a common vision for sustainable mobility and is expected to be proven highly synergistic. This partnership not only provides a significant market for Gensol's vehicles but also contributes significantly to BluSmart's mission of providing sustainable and eco-friendly transportation solutions. By leveraging this partnership, BluSmart is able to offer a reliable and affordable fleet of electric vehicles, demonstrating the viability and convenience of electric mobility to a wider audience. Here is how the market is going to welcome this development–1- Greater Market Share in Ride-hailing Services- As of now, BluSmart occupies only about 2% ride-hailing market in India. However, the company is only present in big cities like Delhi NCR, Bangalore, and Mumbai, where 68% of the nation's mobility market is concentrated. Generally, BluSmart's fleet includes different types of vehicles including Mahindra Tata e-Tigor, e-Verito, Hyundai Kona, Tata Xpres-T EV, Electric, and MG ZS Electric. However, these vehicles are generally hired on a lease basis. BluSmart relies heavily on vehicles leased from Gensol Engineering as well. Around two-thirds of BluSmart's fleet is sourced from Gensol. In the coming times, this self-dependence is going to increase. With the introduction of the EZIO EV, the company might either become less dependent on its previous leasing structure or expand its market even further. Both of the scenarios seem favourable for the company in the long run. Therefore, the introduction of the EZIO seems to be the right step to achieve a greater market share. Competition on Sustainable Manufacturing:At the 13th Annual Kaizen Congress India 2024, Sumit Kumar from Gensol EV’s Manufacturing Quality Assurance team garnered attention for his insights on 'Kaizen for Quality Improvements on the Assembly Line.'His innovative approach to creating Defect Dictionaries and establishing 'Zero Defect Workstations underscores Gensol EV’s commitment to achieving manufacturing excellence,” according to a post by Gensol EV on Linkedin. This recognition not only celebrates Sumit’s dedication but also reinforces the company’s ethos of continuous improvement. This dedication holds moral incentives as well as the brand reliability of the company for its users. The method of sustainable manufacturing is another trend at which companies are slowly transitioning. Aiming for a lower carbon footprint and more sustainable engineering process is the need of the hour for any company that is seeking to expand worldwide. With Gensol entering into the EV segment, the manufacturing process may also get highlighted making companies more accountable to the environment. Autonomous Driving: The Future BeckonsGensol EV’s vision, as highlighted in BISInfotech’s article, emphasizes the transformative potential of autonomous vehicles. Gensol may contribute a significant effort to pave the way for fully autonomous driving, a feature that promises to redefine urban mobility. Autonomous technology not only enhances safety but also optimizes traffic flow, reduces energy consumption, and ensures greater accessibility for all commuters. Although it is still a significantly long way to introduce this technology in the Indian EV market, the continuous launches of EVs in the Indian Ev market like EZIO EV will mark the Industry’s vision to enable such tech soon. Gensol first EV- the EZIOThe EZIO offers promises to redefine urban mobility with a range of up to 200 km and a top speed of 80 kmph, backed by ARAI certification in February 2024.The Ezio’s standout design features include reflector-style LED headlights, a floating roof, charging ports on the front fenders, and wrap-around taillights. Inside, the cabin boasts a layered dashboard, gloss black accents, a large central touchscreen, and premium features like a sunroof and automatic climate control. Its compact yet futuristic design ensures both style and practicality for India’s busy cityscapes.Technologically, the Ezio sets new benchmarks with in-cabin driver assistance technology, AI-driven cloud analytics, and a comprehensive connectivity stack. These innovations enhance safety and deliver a smart, adaptive driving experience.Gensol’s entry into the EV market with the Ezio signals a commitment to sustainable and intelligent mobility. As it takes centre stage at the Bharat Mobility Expo, the EZIO is poised to captivate audiences, symbolizing a forward-thinking approach to eco-friendly transportation.Experience the beginning of a new chapterThe unveiling of EZIO at the Global Expo 2025 is more than a product launch; it's a statement of intent. Gensol EV, with the support of BluSmart and powered by its passion for sustainability and innovation, is all set to drive a lot of change in the EV market. blogs.title: Will Trump’s administration impact the Indian EV market?
blogs.subtitle: Explore how Donald Trump's second-term tariff policies could impact India's EV market and global trade. Learn about potential challenges, opportuni...
blogs.author: Prashant
blogs.description: Explore how Donald Trump's second-term tariff policies could impact India's EV market and global trade. Learn about potential challenges, opportunities, and the ripple effects on India's economy and electric vehicle industry.
blogs.content: The US election's result has observed bittersweet reactions from all over the world. Donald Trump has once again climbed up the presidential chair by riding a worldwide wave of “right” ideology. Since the inception of his 2nd tenure, Donald Trump has already taken decisions to put “America first”. One such decision by the President-elect is to put a 25% tariff on all products imported into the US from Mexico and Canada and a 35% tariff on products from China. This hard-power decision taken by Trump has been feared by many economists throughout the world. But what are they feared about? What does it mean for India? Are EVs in India going to be more expensive? Let's find out!The DecisionIt is safe to say that the steps taken by Trump’s administration do represent the majoritarian will of the American people as he was already advocating for a 60 per cent tariff on imports from China, and 10-20 per cent on others. According to him, high tariffs will boost manufacturing in the US which will rebalance trade with other countries, and improve government finances. The President-elect announced the tariff imposition on the top trading partners of the USA–Mexico, Canada and China on the social media platform Truth Social. Earlier, the Inflation Reduction Act has already introduced various tax credits for EV companies to set up their manufacturing units in the USA. In fact, according to a report by nrdc.org, the USA has already surpassed China as the most favourable country for EV investments. Now, with the tariff hanging over, it will be interesting to note the reactions of the worldwide EV companies. The effect According to research by economists at the Peterson Institute of International Economics, Trump's policies might wind up costing the average American household more than $2,600 a year. Nonetheless, it seems that both Republicans and Democrats support the concept of increasing tariffs. Free market analysts and advocates of globalisation have shown serious concern over Trump’s decision, as the tariff wars between countries may come at a cost of inflation and global slowdown. Amid such volatility, the comparatively nascent market of electric vehicles has also come under threat. Although, as per studies, the USA only accounts for 7-10% contribution to the global supply chain of EVs, the direct repercussions will be faced by the companies who have their manufacturing or assembly units in the USA.  Recent reports by Bloomberg have shown that BYD intends to reduce prices to tackle tariffs and not shift the burden on consumers. The step came after Tesla offered a price cut on its Model Y in China. BYD, the Chinese giant has been in constant competition with Tesla for the rank of No1 in worldwide sales.However, communist China provides a great government intervention to absorb the losses which the company makes in order to remain in the competition. Although this policy is not designed to serve in the long run, BYD has already reported to cut down its prices. Trump’s decision has invoked chances of potential retaliation by Mexico and China, while Canada has started negotiations. Once an advocate of free trade, the USA seems to shift its policy towards protectionist ideas, risking a global slowdown, amid the broken dispute resolution mechanism of the World Trade Organization (WTO).The USA as the third largest EV market in the world accounts for 10% of the overall global market worth, after China accounting for 60% and Europe accounting for 25%. However, in the USA, approximately 70% of the sold EVs are domestically manufactured while $19 billion worth of electric vehicles are imported, according to the USA customs clearance website. Hence, it can be said that after the tariffs, the global EV industry may be affected by at least $19 billion. Moreover, the raw material imported from other countries to manufacture EVs may also add to the losses, taking the number to another higher value. Impact on India India is an import-oriented country whose overall trade remains in deficit, however, India has a trade surplus with the USA. That said, if the inflation in the US market rises, the demand in the market will reduce, ultimately leading to a loss of a considerable amount of India’s foreign exchange. It is also interesting to note that in Trump 1.0, India has already lost its Generalised System of Preference (GSP) status which obliged a developed nation to buy certain products from a developing country. However, as per SBI, there has been a significant rise in the trade of India with the USA despite revoking the GSP status which is a good sign for the overall Indian market. With bilateral trade over $120 billion in FY24, the US continues to be India's largest trading partner, marginally surpassing India's trade with China. India's dependence on the US market has increased over the last ten years; currently, 18% of India's exports go to the US, up from 10% in 2010–11. India exports a wide range of products to the US, including engineering equipment, electronics, and textiles.The EV companies planning to launch themselves in the US market might have to change their plans. On the other hand, the earlier cut in the fed rates by the USA might indicate a good time for EV companies to go global. Hence, EV companies must navigate between this opportunity and challenge to make their way to the world. Whereas, when it comes to pricing, it is highly unlikely that any Indian EV company will significantly change the cost of its EV due to this update.

blogs.title: Mahindra Charges Ahead: Unveiling India's First Homegrown Electric SUVs - XEV 9e & BE 6e
blogs.subtitle: Discover Mahindra’s game-changing electric SUVs, XEV 9e & BE 6e, built on the revolutionary INGLO platform. With cutting-edge technology, impressiv...
blogs.author: Tarpan Vyas
blogs.description: Discover Mahindra’s game-changing electric SUVs, XEV 9e & BE 6e, built on the revolutionary INGLO platform. With cutting-edge technology, impressive range, and futuristic design, these 'Born Electric' SUVs redefine sustainable mobility in India.
blogs.content: From the dawn of India’s farm mechanisation to the journey of electric vehicles, Mahindra is a well-known name in Indian markets. The company has a rich history of collaboration and teamwork shared with companies in the UK, USA, France and others which has given a legacy of customer-understanding to the company. Driving through farms, the company has entered the FIA Formula E championship as well.Keeping the pace of time, Mahindra has evolved as the world transitions to electric vehicles (EVs).  When it comes to the L5 electric vehicle segment in India, Mahindra holds a dominant 41.2% market share (SIAM). Moreover, Mahindra has sold over 100,000 EVs in the past 17 months, fueled by advanced products like the Treo Plus, e-Alfa Plus, and Mahindra ZEO. Their commitment to a sustainable future is further highlighted by the UDAY NXT loyalty program, offering ₹ 20 Lakh* driver accidental insurance cover to new EV buyers.  Today, we witness a significant milestone: the unveiling of India's first homegrown 'Born Electric' SUVs – the XEV 9e and BE 6e.INGLO: The Foundation for Electric SupremacyThe XEV 9e and BE 6e are based on the revolutionary INGLO Electric Origin Architecture. This platform marks a high-tech departure from the past, designed from the ground up exclusively for electric vehicles. INGLO is the 'Electric Origin' philosophy which breaks away from the the limitations of existing platforms and forges a path for the future of electric mobility.A key feature of INGLO is its lightweight, skateboard structure with a flat floor. This design principle, with high-density battery technology, maximizes the interior space. The design provides a roomy, comfortable cabins offering enhanced seating flexibility. The platform's modularity allows for the creation of diverse models, catering to a range of preferences – from the athletic BE 6e to the elegant XEV 9e, without compromising on performance or quality. Passengers will have a superlative driving experience – lighter, more agile, and incredibly spacious.Range Anxiety? A Thing of the PastINGLO tackles a major challenge for EVs – range anxiety.  With robust battery options of 59 kWh and 79 kWh, these SUVs offer a class-leading range, putting an end to worries about frequent charging. Furthermore, INGLO utilizes advanced LFP battery chemistry and standardized cell-to-pack technology. This translates to long-lasting durability, exceptional safety, and unwavering reliability.But innovation doesn't stop there. INGLO boasts fast-charging capabilities, allowing you to charge from 20% to 80% in a mere 20 minutes using a 175 kW DC charger.  Whether you're embarking on a long road trip or navigating city commutes, INGLO ensures a seamless and stress-free experience.Safety remains paramount, and INGLO prioritizes it with features like ultra-high-strength boron steel and reinforced frontal structures. This unwavering commitment to safety ensures the XEV 9e and BE 6e are built to endure, able to withstand extreme heat and rigorous crash tests, keeping you confident on every journey.Thrilling Performance, Unmatched HandlingExciting driving experiences await in both the XEV 9e and BE 6e, with INGLO providing a compact three-in-one powertrain including motor, inverter, and transmission for great performance creating power outputs in the range of 170 kW to 210 kW for rear-wheel-drive variants. The vehicles boast a semi-active suspension system for best-in-class handling, high-power steering, and brake-by-wire technology to deliver a smooth yet thrilling ride experience. In conjunction with this, INGLO will feature intelligent drive modes for turning the SUV so that it adjusts to the terrain accordingly at the touch of a button leaving the vehicle and driver in oneness.A Glimpse into the Future: Technology and DesignWhile full specifications remain under wraps, the XEV 9e and BE 6e are anticipated to be technological marvels offering luxurious comfort. The XEV 9e might feature a futuristic triple-screen dashboard layout, while the BE 6e could boast a dual-screen setup.  Both models are expected to include a panoramic sunroof, a nearly square steering wheel with haptic buttons, and illuminated branding.  Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS) controls are also expected to be integrated into the steering, along with toggle buttons and paddle shifters for regenerative braking.  The centre console designs are likely to differ between the two models, with the XEV 9e potentially offering a third screen for the front passenger.The design language for both SUVs embraces a futuristic aesthetic, integrating sharp design elements tailored for modern EV enthusiasts.  The XEV 9e could feature a connected LED light bar at the front, complemented by vertical lighting elements, a closed grille, and a sleek bonnet adorned with Mahindra's new EV-specific logo.  In contrast, the BE 6e is expected to flaunt its unique identity with a BE logo at the front, alongside a design inspired by the XUV 3XO concept.Both SUVs are expected to showcase bold character lines, expansive wheel arches housing 18-inch alloy wheels, and connected LED tail lights at the rear.  The BE 6e also distinguishes itself with a coupe-like roofline, enhancing its sportier appeal.A New Era DawnsMahindra & Mahindra Ltd. is currently keeping all eyes on upcoming products, putting aside the dwindling sales of its only electric model, the Mahindra XUV400, as expressed earlier by Rajesh Jejurikar, Executive Director, Auto and Farm Sectors, Mahindra and Mahindra Ltd. Thus, the XUV400, which sold 1,800 units, will not become the focus of the entire company in the electric vehicle market anymore. Rather, Mahindra will invest and allocate resources toward the two products, XEV 9e and BE 6e, which will have exclusive production lines at its Chakan set-up for these vehicles.These products redefine electric mobility as India steps into a future where electric mobility is celebrated. They drag on by virtue of their own innovative INGLO platform, cutting-edge technology, and stunning design, ensuring the most exciting and cleanest mobility experience on Indian roads. In no time, we will be able to witness these officially unveiled; till then, we can rest assured that Mahindra will always remain ahead of the game, bringing life into the future of electric mobility in India.

blogs.content: Yakuza, a company known for its resilience and hard work, has acquired a significant position in the EV industry. Among big names in the EV market, it is very common for companies to get lost in the crowd, but by defying this common trend Yakuza with its wide offering of electric vehicles has come to be known as an underdog in the industry. As a pioneering EV company with high-end manufacturing facilities across India, Yakuza is committed to providing affordable and efficient electric mobility solutions. Their latest offering, the Karishma, is a testament to this commitment, which offers a compelling proposition for budget-conscious urban commuters.A Glimpse into Yakuza's VisionYakuza, under the aegis of Maa Luxmi E-vehicle Pvt. Ltd., is working to provide more than just an EV to its users. The company stands on the vision and mission to revolutionise urban mobility. Meanwhile, with a dedicated engineering and design division certified by the International Centre for Automotive Technology (ICAT), Yakuza ensures the safety and reliability of its products along with being innovative and creative.Moreover, the company's focus on sustainability and reducing carbon emissions is encapsulated in its wide range of electric scooters and the company’s micro e-car. By offering a range of electric vehicles, including the Karishma, Yakuza empowers individuals to make eco-friendly choices without compromising on convenience or affordability.Introducing the Yakuza Karishma: A Compact Electric MarvelThe Karishma, a compact electric car, is designed to navigate the bustling city streets with ease. Its sleek design, featuring new-generation alloy wheels, a stylish grill, and bold LED DRLs, gives it a modern and eye-catching appearance.Performance-wise, the Karishma is provided with a smart start/stop system and smart gear knob for efficient operation. The Karishma draws power from a 60V 45Ah battery and drives 50 to 60 kilometres on a single charge, hence perfect for daily commutes. Provided with a one-year warranty, its 1250W electric motor gives smooth and reliable performance.Inside the cabin, the Karishma offers a comfortable and convenient driving experience. It can carry up to three passengers with a ventilated roof for better airflow. The reverse parking camera and power steering facilitate handling, while power windows add to the luxury. Moreover, there is also a small digital screen that shows the speed and battery level.A Green Choice for Urban LivingThe compact size and slow pace of the Karishma are two of its main features which provide the vehicle its unique selling point as, with a top speed of about 25 to 30 km/h and no registration requirements, it's a hassle-free choice for city commuters. Additionally, this helps to cut pollutants and transportation congestion.Selecting the Yakuza Karishma is not only a cost-effective and practical way to get around, but it's also a step towards a more environmentally friendly future. In the upcoming years, we may anticipate seeing more innovative and environmentally friendly electric vehicles as Yakuza keeps developing and growing its product line.

blogs.title: Looking for EV? need loan? Get it in 5 mins that's too from Green NBFCs
blogs.subtitle: Looking to finance your electric vehicle? Green NBFCs likeEcofy, and evfin by Greaves offer affordable, quick EV loans with easy approvals. Enjoy r...
blogs.author: Prashant
blogs.description: Looking to finance your electric vehicle? Green NBFCs likeEcofy, and evfin by Greaves offer affordable, quick EV loans with easy approvals. Enjoy rates as low as 5.99% and get your loan approved in just 5 minutes!
blogs.content: Enjoying easily available loans for vehicles is a rare luxury. And when it comes to EVs, the lane gets more narrower. However, with the rise of EV financing institutions like Green NBFCs (Non-banking financing companies), financing your EV is now easier than ever before. Companies like Ecofy and evfin by Greaves many others have entered the EV financing market to offer a wholesome EV financing Ecosystem, so much so that the companies are now providing a 5-minute loan procedure!What exactly are Green NBFCs? How they are better? Green NBFCs are institutions that provide cheap and easy loans to any entity that has decided to reduce its carbon footprint. Green NBFCs are the answer to the problems customers generally face when they seek loans for their electric vehicles from regular banks. The main issues lie in the availability, process, and terms & conditions of the loans often provided by these banks. And how NBFCs are better? Simple! Because they solve these issues.How are Green NBFCs better?The Rate of Interest by these NBFCs, generally, starts from 5.99 % only, unlike the high-rate loans given by banks. Obviously, it depends on your CIBIL score. Well, some banks do provide lower interest rates, however, on average any bank takes 1-2 days for any loan approval. In contrast, a Green NBFC only takes a minimum of 5 minutes to approve your loan.Moreover, banks charge you a significant amount in the case of foreclosure but when it comes to NBFCs these charges are next to nothing and sometimes, literally nothing. In addition, financial products by green NBFCs are optimised for EV purchases, unlike banks’ general financial products for every vehicle. Sometimes due to your CIBIL score, you might not be eligible for loans in banks but NBFCs might help you out. How to claim your 5-min loan?Although all Green NBFCs follow almost the same procedure, some steps might differ or vary depending on the company. But not to worry, if you are stuck anywhere in between, just call our EVGURUS at 9099900563 and we will help you navigate through this journey. To apply for any EV loan we highly recommend you thoroughly refer to the steps mentioned below– Step1- Login to your NBFC appAfter selecting your Green NBFC, open the page and log in with your phone number to create your ID. You will receive an OTP to finalise your profile. Step2- Select VehicleAfter logging in, choose the EV which you want to buy. Assuming that you are trying to finance your EV only after selecting your preference, just search for your favourite ride for which you want to sanction your loan.Step3- Digital KYCThe NBFC app will further require you to perform the “Know Your Customer (KYC)” exercise. In this, you have to upload your documents such as an Aadhar Card, PAN card, Income Proof, an additional address verification document such as an electricity bill and some other family background details.Step 4- Bureau check Further, the app will check your CIBIL score and customise an offer for you.Step 5- Offer Generation Following the Bureau Check, you will be provided with a loan offer starting from Rate Of Interest(ROI) as low as 5.99%. Moreover, you will get to know the downpayment options which you can opt as per your requirements. Step 6- eNACH processElectronic National Automated Clearing House or eNACH is a process to verify your bank account details from which your instalments will be paid. The NBFC will first ask customers to enter their bank details and then usually sends Rs1 to the customer’s account for verification. For further authenticity, the NBFC might also ask you to upload your Digital sign and a selfie. Following the procedure and after accepting all the terms and conditions, the user can proceed to the next step.Step 7- Sanction letter- Hurray! The Loan Approved!Following the eNACH step, the NBFC institution will take a few minutes to process all the data and will provide a hand-to-hand sanction letter of loan approval. And VIOLA, We are halfway there!Step 8- Walk into your nearest showroomNow walk into your nearest showroom and show your sanction letter to the Dealer. After crosschecking all the details, submit your downpayment amount and receive a receipt for your payment. If you are planning to buy your ride online, then also you don’t have to worry a bit. You can contact the dealer in virtual mode and make all transactions online. In the end, you will just need the receipt of the downpayment, either hardcopy or softcopy no worries. Step 9-  Submit the receipt & enter personal detailsThe downpayment receipt received from the dealer is further needed to be uploaded on NBFC’s platform. After uploading the receipt, the user is asked to enter personal information such as address proof, income proof and some other documents. Here, the same documents that you may have uploaded for the digital KYC will be needed again to move further.Step 10- UTR generation And just like this, your loan will be disbursed. The NBFC platform will generate a Unique Transaction Reference(UTR) as proof of loan disbursement. The customer is required to share this UTR with the dealer in order to check the completion of the transaction. Step 11-  Enjoy your rideWell done! You have hit the jackpot of EV financing deals! Now roll out your brand new EV from the showroom and make your journey more beautiful than the destination!Attaboy NBFCs! Switching the commute trend from conventional gasoline-powered vehicles to electric counterparts is a challenging job. This transition of trend is further pushed by the government’s subsidy and EV companies' constant effort to provide a pocket-friendly product. However, the importance of credit-providing companies is often overlooked in this sector. It is for companies like Ecofy, and evfin by Greaves and many more to carry the responsibility of bridging the transition cost for EV enthusiasts. Creating a comprehensive ecosystem is very necessary to promote EV adoption in India and Green NBFCs with their optimised and cheap EV loans are an important stakeholder in the revolution. So if you are looking to finance your EV, then these NBFCs are worth checking out!

blogs.title: Ather Fast Charging Stations in India: Locations, Numbers, and Cost
blogs.subtitle: Discover Ather Energy’s fast-charging network in India: 2700+ stations across 230 cities, affordable costs, and support for other EV brands. Explor...
blogs.author: Tarpan Vyas
blogs.description: Discover Ather Energy’s fast-charging network in India: 2700+ stations across 230 cities, affordable costs, and support for other EV brands. Explore Ather Grid’s strategic locations, pricing plans, and the role it plays in India’s EV revolution.
blogs.content: The growing demand for cleaner, sustainable modes of transportation has fueled the rise of electric vehicles (EVs) in India. Among the front-runners in the EV two-wheeler segment is Ather Energy, a Bengaluru-based startup that has made a significant impact with its innovative electric scooters. Established in 2013 by Tarun Mehta and Swapnil Jain, Ather Energy has introduced cutting-edge electric scooters and invested heavily in building a robust charging infrastructure across India. Ather’s fast-charging stations, branded as Ather Grid, form the backbone of its efforts to make electric two-wheelers a viable and convenient option for the Indian public. This blog explores the Ather grid charging station locations, numbers, costs associated with these stations, and how these stations play a crucial role in the country's EV revolution.Ather Energy with its wide spectrum of service plans - Ather Care, Ather Care Plus, and Ather Care Max - is designed to cater to varying customer needs. These plans cover a duration of one year or 10,000 kilometres, whichever comes first, offering extensive maintenance options to ensure a seamless ownership experience. These plans provide varying levels of service, ensuring that customers can select a package tailored to their usage and preferences. This move highlights Ather’s commitment to customer satisfaction, alongside its efforts to build a robust charging infrastructure.Where are Ather Fast Charging Stations Located?Ather Energy has strategically positioned its fast-charging stations across India to ensure convenience for electric scooter users. The Ather Grid network is primarily found in metropolitan cities, tier-2 cities, and key commercial hubs, making it easier for riders to find charging points during daily commutes or longer journeys. The company has placed these stations at malls, cafes, office spaces, tech parks, gyms, and other frequently visited locations to enhance accessibility. The goal is to ensure EV riders never experience range anxiety, a common concern for electric vehicle owners.Strategically placed, these stations offer fast and reliable charging, enabling riders to quickly recharge and get back on the road. Ather Grid stations are equipped with fast chargers that drastically reduce charging time. Using the Ather Grid app, riders can locate nearby stations, get real-time charger availability, and track their sessions remotely. Charging stations are found in cities like Bengaluru, Chennai, Hyderabad, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, Ahmedabad, and Kolkata, with Ather expanding to smaller cities. If you are not using Ather Grid App then also it’s completely alright, just instead of blindly searching “Ather charging station near me,” explore authenticated charging offered by the company itself (click here and find the Ather charging station near you). This aligns with Ather's vision of ensuring easy access to charging facilities across India, promoting the shift to electric vehicles.How Many Fast Charging Stations Does Ather Have?As of 2024, Ather Energy boasts an extensive network of fast-charging stations. With Ather Grid, the company has established over 2700+ charging points across India which is 230+ cities, and the number continues to rise as Ather aggressively expands its network. The company plans to further expand in the years to come. This makes Ather one of the leading players in terms of EV charging infrastructure in India’s two-wheeler segment.The company has strategically chosen high-traffic locations for its charging stations, ensuring that customers have access to a reliable charging solution no matter where they are in a major city. Ather's fast chargers are designed to work seamlessly with its range of scooters, offering convenience and speed to customers. Additionally, Ather continues to partner with various establishments such as restaurants, tech parks, and malls to further expand the network, making charging even more accessible to everyday commuters.Charging Costs at Ather Fast Charging StationsOne of the key advantages of Ather’s fast-charging infrastructure is its pricing model, designed to be affordable and straightforward. Initially, Ather offered free charging as a promotion for the Ather Grid network. However, as the network expanded and the adoption of electric scooters increased, Ather introduced a paid model in several locations.The charging cost typically depends on the location and type of service. As of 2024, Ather Energy offers a subscription-based model for its users, providing a set number of free charging sessions each month at Ather Grid stations. For those exceeding the free limit or without a subscription, a per-minute pricing system is in place. On average, the cost is approximately ₹15-20 per session, allowing for a top-up of about 15 km of range in 10 minutes, depending on the charge needed.Factors influencing charging costs include battery size and capacity, charging efficiency, local electricity rates, and charging speed. For frequent users, the subscription model is a cost-effective choice, while the pay-as-you-go system offers flexibility for occasional users. As Ather expands its network and more EVs hit the road, the company continuously evaluates its pricing to keep it competitive while maintaining premium charging speeds.Do Ather Fast Chargers Support Other Brand EVs?Taking the developing phase of the Indian EV industry into account, it makes less sense for companies to isolate their charging infrastructure for other electric vehicles. So, yes, you can charge other electric vehicles (EVs) that follow the IS17017 (Part 2 / Sec 7) 2023 connector standard. The standard represents a category of light electric vehicles (LEVs), vehicles i.e. electric two- and three-wheelers, and microcars. Moving a step forward, the company has also unveiled its connector technology which will enable any electric vehicle to explore “fast-charging” solutions across the country, irrespective of the brand of the electric vehicle.Moreover, in an exclusive move, Ather Energy has teamed up with Hero Vida to provide a wide range of charging stations to their users. This relationship translates into the user’s convenience in fast charging their respective electric scooter in any charging station operated by Ather or Vida. This partnership is one of its kind as the Ather Grid option does not provide the fast-charging option to other EVs; it provides just a regular charging point. However, if the user owns a Vida electric scooter, they can fast-charge their electric scooter in Ather grid. How Fast is Ather's Fast Charging?One of the standout features of Ather’s fast-charging network is its speed. Ather scooters are equipped with lithium-ion batteries that support fast charging, and the Ather Grid stations are capable of charging these batteries at 1.5 km of range per minute. This means that in just 10 minutes of charging, a rider can add approximately 15 km to their scooter’s range. This quick top-up feature is particularly beneficial for urban commuters who may need a fast charge during their daily travel or in emergencies.The fast-charging capability ensures that Ather owners can minimize downtime and quickly get back on the road. The fast-charging stations offer the convenience of charging up to 80% of the battery in about 40-50 minutes, depending on the model and the starting charge level. This makes Ather’s fast-charging network one of the most efficient for two-wheelers in India, offering a significant reduction in waiting time compared to home charging.Maintaining a premium imageJust like Nilis Bohlin’s invention of the three-point seat belt for Volvo, who launched his product patent-free, embracing safety over profit, Ather Energy can also follow this “high road”. No doubt, the R&D of Ather Energy is dedicated to promoting the charging EV infrastructure of India, the technologies like Grid Network and Connector can truly benefit the entire ecosystem. With the Ather Grid network, the company is addressing one of the key challenges in EV adoption: access to fast, reliable, and widespread charging solutions. As India continues to shift towards electric mobility, Ather Energy’s proactive approach to building a fast-charging network will likely serve as a blueprint for other companies aiming to establish their presence in the EV market.

From Reels’/ Short’s comment sections to Quora and WhatsApp University, the most recurring argument given against EV adoption is that the price of the battery replacement will ultimately make your EV cost equal to its ICE counterpart. But is it really true? Not surprisingly, all such claims you come across on social media are generally based on a single philosophy i.e. “I HEARD SOMEWHERE”.

No doubt, the battery is the heart of an electric vehicle, which asks for replacement after 8-10 years (approx). All over the internet, you will find various articles showing varying costs of battery replacement prices. To be honest, companies do not generally reveal their battery replacement costs for whatever reasons, but you don’t have to worry because EVINDIA is at your service. From the extensive market study, we have deduced one thing for sure, the replacement cost may vary from company to company despite the battery being of the same capacity. However, it is still possible to get a specific detailed idea about any such future expenses. In this blog, we will give you a detailed analysis of the battery-replacement cost of the major companies in the 2-wheeler electric vehicle segment so that you can make an informed choice. 

Battery Type & Capacity

Electric Vehicles are majorly equipped with Lithium-ion batteries whose capacities are measured in kWh (Kilowatt hours). In the two-wheeler segments, batteries generally start from 2kWh and go up to 4kWh, according to your increasing budget. As you might have suspected, the battery replacement price is higher for higher-capacity batteries. 

The main thing to note here is that, unlike the general perception, batteries do not get completely torn off overnight. Actually, batteries consist of multiple cells which in the course of time start to degrade and result in lower range and efficiency. Let me extinguish some of your worries here, these cells are repairable which in turn can extend your overall battery life.

Now you might say “So what, we still would have to change our battery after some time” Well yes! But that doesn’t mean it is going to cost you more or equal than ICE vehicles. Let me make my case!

Ola Battery Price

The 2-wheeler EV giant Ola Electric provides a range of electric vehicles, from 2kWh battery capacity to 4kWh. In the 2kWh battery segment, the company provides the Ola S1X model whose battery will cost you somewhere around ₹55,000. On the other hand, the battery of the company’s higher-performance vehicle, the Ola S1X 4kWh variant will cost around Rs ₹80,000 to ₹85,000. Each and every electric scooter of Ola Electric including the company’s flagship product Ola S1 Pro’s battery price also is between ₹87,000 to ₹90,000.

Refer to the list below to learn in detail about Ola electric battery prices.

Ola S1 Pro battery price: ₹87,000 to ₹90,000

Ola S1 Air battery price: ₹70,000

Ola S1 X (4kWh) battery price: ₹80,000 to ₹85,000

Ola S1 X (3kWh) battery price: ₹70,000

Ola S1 X (2kWh) battery price: ₹55,000

Ola S1 X+ battery price: Similar to S1 X models, around ₹70,000

Bajaj Chetak Battery Price

The legacy of “Humara Bajaj” in the electric version is well celebrated in the Indian EV industry. The company’s offering starts from 2.8kWh battery capacity in its Chetak 2901 variant and goes up to 3.2kWh in the newly launched Chetak 3201. The company provides all of its vehicles in 2 options i.e. Standard and Techpac. Techpac introduces some extra features and riding modes in your vehicle. Although the Chetak battery price does not depend on whatever option you buy, the life of the battery may vary according to the “models” on which you drive your vehicle. 

For the overall fleet, the Bajaj Chetak battery prices range from ₹60,000 to ₹80,000 depending on the model​ and its battery capacity.

Ather Battery Price

The “premium” brand of the electric 2-wheeler segment, Ather Energy whose market share is consistently growing in the EV industry, when it comes to its success, has something to do with its battery management strategies. The company’s robust service centres along with its 5-year warranty (8 years extended), have been able to create trust in the audience. The company provides 2.9kWh powered electric scooters such as Ather 450X and high-performance scooters such as Ather Rizta that are powered with 3.7 kWh battery. Concerning its cost, the Ather battery prices lie under the spectrum of ₹60,000 to ₹80,000. Moreover, to know Ather battery prices in detail refer to the list below :

Ather 450X (2.9 kWh): ₹65,000 to ₹70,000

Ather 450X (3.7 kWh): ₹80,000

Ather 450S: ₹60,000

Ather Rizta: should follow Ather 450X pricing, between ₹65,000 and ₹80,000.

Vida Battery Price

The Vida electric vehicles, backed by Hero Motors, are one of the top contenders in the EV industry whose products are widely appreciated and loved. So, if you too are planning to buy a Vida electric scooter and have concerns about its battery price, then don’t worry we have your back. The company provides only 2 electric vehicles, V1 Pro and V1 Plus, with 3.9 kWh and 3.4 kWh of battery capacity respectively. Both vehicles come with 2 removable batteries that can be charged at your convenience. The company provides a 5-year warranty on their electric scooter which includes 24x7 roadside assistance, Home Services and many more facilities. 

In case of replacement, the Hero Vida V1 Pro battery price will be ₹85,000 approximately. Whereas, the company’s other vehicle Hero Vida V1 Plus battery will cost you around ₹75,000.

TVS Battery price

Another legacy brand in our EV list is TVS Motors. This company is an exception when it comes to battery capacity! What makes it so exceptional is its TVS iQube St electric scooter which comes with a non-conventional, unprecedented, 5.1kWh battery. The brand claims a whooping “real” range of 150km and provides a 3-year or 50,000 km (whichever arrives first) warranty. Well, but wait! There is a slight problem. This vehicle variant has not hit the roads yet! The company has already received orders, but the delivery date is yet to be announced. Therefore, we were not able to find a substantive range of its battery price.

The company’s other electric vehicle variant, TVS iQube (3.04 kWh) is also an embodiment of perfection whose battery replacement will cost you around Rs ₹60,000 to ₹70,000. Meanwhile, if you own or are planning to own a TVS Iqube ST electric scooter then battery replacement can cost you around ₹90,000.

Consumers were bombarded with so much scattered and confusing information. blogs.title: Buy Ola S1 @49,999: Introducing BOSS – The Biggest Ola Season Sale

blogs.author: Prashant
blogs.description: Moreover, the earlier pricey Ola S1 Pro is now available with a ₹20,000 discount and goes for ₹1,14,999. S1 Pro is the flagship from Ola and comes with more speed, more range, and more features.
blogs.content: The festival season is the ideal time for consumers to splurge since manufacturers dangle varieties of discounts and offers. Continuing this spree, Ola Electric, India's fastest-growing electric vehicle manufacturer, announced their biggest festival sale under the banner of BOSS - Biggest Ola Season Sale. This sale promises big announcements, bigger launches, and the biggest deals, which all lead the way for consumers to embrace the electric revolution by switching over to eco-friendly electric vehicles (EVs). With this initiative, Ola is not just expecting to advance its market position but also enable customers to ride home the 'BOSS' of all EVs - the Ola S1 series.This festive sale is particularly crucial as Ola Electric is entering a phase of high-simmering competition in the electric two-wheeler market and also sales decline. The continuous loss of market share by the company makes the time of this offer crucial for the company. However, this BOSS sale could turn out to be quite strategic enough to revive the interest of consumers and therefore the demand for these electric two-wheelers. Here's what the BOSS sale has in store, and why now is the perfect time to go electric with Ola:Big Announcements and Bigger DealsOla Electric has lined up some of the most attractive deals the EV market has ever seen under its BOSS sale. The most eye-catching announcement of all is the cut on the much-in-demand Ola S1X 2kwhr variant which now stands at ₹49,999 (terms and conditions applied). As this offer brings up to ₹25,000 off on the market price, it marks a new benchmark for affordable electric scooters in India. The Ola S1 X boasts impressive styling, intelligent features, and a robust performance. Thus, it is a great option for any first-time EV buyer.There is much more play with the Ola S1 range, given the sign of the biggest discounts across its portfolio beyond the S1 X. Moreover, the earlier pricey Ola S1 Pro is now available with a ₹20,000 discount and goes for ₹1,14,999. S1 Pro is the flagship from Ola and comes with more speed, more range, and more features, and this deal will appeal a lot to performance-centric electric scooter seekers.For the mid-range-seeker, there's also the Ola S1 Air available with a discount of ₹1,00,499. That cuts the original price tag by ₹7,000. This model has a light design and, with a decent on-paper range, is suitable for an urban commute. And yet more benefits for an all-rounded experienceSale does not mean cutting prices alone. Ola Electric has taken it further by offering trade-in benefits of up to ₹25,000 across its S1 range. So, an exchange bonus will reward the existing two-wheeler owners as well as trade in their old vehicle for a discount on a new Ola scooter. Additionally, access features of smart technology are also available in more advanced forms through app connectivity, navigation, and over-the-air updates for maximum user experience.Ola is also offering an extended warranty of 8 years on select models to give further peace of mind to consumers. This approach gives full confidence to the company on the durability and reliability of its electric scooters.If such concerns about charges remain, Ola to its credit has introduced fast-charging credits that could be a game-changer for city riders. With such advantages, the BOSS sale is no longer discounted but a complete package designed to make the switch to electric as convenient and inexpensive as possible. It's also a response to falling sales.It is a crucial time for Ola Electric, which has seen sales drop for months. In September 2024, the company recorded its lowest monthly sales of the year at 23,965 units, marking the second straight month of month-on-month decline. In addition, the market share for the company is as modest as 27% in September, having declined from more than 50% in April, indicating the growing level of competition in the EV space.Several factors have led to this collapse: greater competition from the traditional two-wheeler stalwarts like TVS Motor and Bajaj Auto, who came out with more modern models at competitive prices. The above companies gradually and consistently ate into the market share of Ola, so a major promotional thrust in the form of the BOSS sale was all the more imperative.The company's CEO Bhavish Aggarwal announced the BOSS sale through microblogging platform X, formerly Twitter, as a clear indicator that the company is eager to return to the market.The sale has been touted as an opportunity not only to bring new customers on board but also to reactivate old ones through special referral programs. Referral program and customer reactivationBesides these discounts and benefits, the Referral Program of Ola Electric continues, where it has been very popular among its customers. Any owner can refer friends or family to buy an Ola electric scooter, from which both the referrer and the new buyer will benefit. A referrer receives a reward worth ₹2,000, and a new customer receives a discount worth ₹1,000. Through this process, the brand promotes community engagement around the brand while offering an incentive to existing users through monetary rewards to further the sales of electric scooters from Ola.Time to Make the SwitchThis will be the perfect time for those interested in switching to electric, and they can ride home in the 'BOSS' of all EVs. Whether the eco-conscious commuter or the new, cost-effective ride, something is there in Ola's BOSS for everybody. The BOSS sale represents a perfect combination of festival delight and trust-building measures by the company. No doubt, it marks an important ambition for Ola Electric in its journey to success despite strong competition in the market. Innovative models and attractive prices through a customer-first approach would help Ola Electric achieve a good bounce back during the festival season.

blogs.title: How Indian future EV industry looks like: Post PM E-Drive Expectations
blogs.subtitle: The Indian electric vehicle market is going to grow dramatically in the coming years. Annual volume will reach as high as 10 million units by 2033 ...
blogs.author: Prashant
blogs.description: The Indian electric vehicle market is going to grow dramatically in the coming years. Annual volume will reach as high as 10 million units by 2033 from 1.7 million units during the financial year 2023-24.
blogs.content: India is all set to play a pivotal role in the rapid transformation of the global electric vehicle (EV) market. The global market for EVs is estimated to be at $255 billion, according to a report just published by Axis Securities and is seen to take off to $2,108 billion by 2033. This would mean that it will have recorded a CAGR of around 23% during the period from 2023 to 2033. It tells us about the rising demand for mobility solutions to meet the need for cleaner alternatives, especially in countries like India, as rapid urbanisation and rising environmental concerns form the basis of their demands.Indian Electric Vehicle Market GrowthThe Indian electric vehicle market is going to grow dramatically in the coming years. Annual volume will reach as high as 10 million units by 2033 from 1.7 million units during the financial year 2023-24. This growth will be governed by various factors in the form of government policies, new product launches, cost reduction of raw materials to manufacture, and rapid technological developments.The country's EV revolution will not only be limited to 2W and 3W. In the coming decade, the adoption of electric buses, passenger vehicles, and even heavy-duty trucks is expected to pick up pace. Infrastructure improvement coupled with affordable electric vehicle models in the market are the root cause of this projected growth.Government SupportThe Indian government has played an important role in pushing EV adoption across the nation. Replenishing the exhausted FAME, which stood for Faster Adoption and Manufacturing of Electric and Hybrid Vehicles in India, the new PM E-Drive Scheme is part of several electric two-wheelers and three-wheeler subsidies totalling ₹10,900 crore, all to be released within the next two years, for a push on selling electric two, three, and four wheelers. The proposal will support the sale of 24.79 lakh two-wheelers, 3.16 lakh three-wheelers, and 14,028 e-buses by 2025.The government's new tax-friendly policy has made EVs affordable. Electric cars are taxed at a mere 5%, while hybrid vehicles pay a 28% tax, and the heavy tax of 49% is borne by the ICE vehicles. So, all these incentives have levelled the playing field for EVs, and consumers will find them increasingly accessible, driving further growth.Infrastructure Development: The Driver of GrowthThe best part that would lead to widespread EV acceptance is the robust charging infrastructure. Keeping in view this very demand, the Indian government is going to spend ₹2,000 crores in developing public EV charging stations. Of course, these funds would support the installation of 22,100 fast chargers for electric four-wheelers, 1,800 for electric buses and 48,400 for electric two and three-wheelers. This infrastructure development is even more necessary because range anxiety remains one of the most significant concerns of potential EV buyers.For example, to promote electric trucks and ambulances, ₹ 500 crores have been put towards supporting the adoption of electric trucks. Similarly, ₹ 500 crores have been allocated for hybrid and fully electric ambulances. These are not only meeting the high-rising demands for clean commercial and emergency vehicles but also indicate the long-term vision of the government as the sector-wide supports EVs.Rising Semiconductor Industry in IndiaBy far, the biggest challenge for the EV industry is indeed the availability of semiconductors. Electric vehicles are essentially run by semiconductors- everything from battery efficiency to vehicle safety systems. India has made its strides here: the country has been working relentlessly to develop its own semiconductor manufacturing capacities.The collaborations with the US, Japan, and Australia provide India a platform to establish itself as a major leader in the semiconductor sector. An example can be cited in the form of awarding the government project of setting up the semiconductor manufacturing plant to 3RrdiTech Inc., the leader in a technology house. This is very important because the government feels that for these few vital elements of electric vehicles demanded increasingly, control over the supply chain must be independently warranted.For this purpose, entry into semiconductor manufacturing can be seen as a forward-looking approach not just for the EV sector but all other dependent sectors on the technology, such as telecom and consumer electronics. If such initiatives work out well, India plans to restrict its reliance on imports and will ensure that the EV sector keeps growing free from interference by outside forces.EV Revolution in India - A Reality, Not a MythIndia's electric vehicle revolution is no more a dream, but increasingly real. At a time when the world EV market is projected to touch more than $2 trillion by 2033, India is gaining momentum in becoming one of the leaders in this space. India government policies such as the PM E-Drive Scheme, along with investment in subsidies, lowering taxes and more emphasis on infrastructure development, will see more EVs emerging on the roads in the years to come.This focus on making semiconductors domestically in India will be crucial to keeping the momentum of the Indian EV industry going. Association with global partners and further local supply chain development will reduce the costs of manufacturing even further and help India reach its ambitious targets.The future of India's EV industry is promising. Growth there has been achieved through innovation and policy support. The country continues to embrace sustainable mobility solutions, and thereby the figure for EVs on Indian roads will continue to rise, doing its part for global carbon emissions reduction and fighting climate change. The EV revolution is here, and it's only going to get bigger.

blogs.content: On Sept 9th the people of the world came together to celebrate World EV Day, marking the fifth anniversary of the celebration from its beginning. Well, obviously it is not a Diwali, Christmas or Thanksgiving, but the very existence of this day is based on the need to adopt a cleaner and greener commute option worldwide. One can say that this initiative is really showing its colours, as to push EV adoption further beyond, an Indian electric two-wheeler company Oben Electric has decided to push for “EV inclusivity”. The company has announced its plans to launch 4 new electric two-wheelers in the upcoming six months starting from an unprecedented price of Rs 60,000, making the transition cost practically zero. The premium-ride seeking customers have also much to look for, as the company’s offering will go up to Rs 1,50,000, providing a high-performance electric travelling partner. Oben Electric being a flag holder of the “Make in India” campaign boasts an intention to lead the charge in revolutionising India’s electric mobility landscape by offering innovative solutions to meet the rising demand of the world’s third-largest automobile industry. The upcoming vehicles underline the company’s commitment to providing sustainable, efficient and high-tech features within an affordable range. The company in its ambitious press statement has revealed that they are trying to tap into the yet-to-tap motorcycle segment of India's EV industry. Oben has observed that the motorcycle segment of the EV industry is only 30% catered while leaving the potential 70% empty. Oben with its launch of new vehicles seeks to fit into this void. By already setting a good example from its previous Rorr vehicle, launched in 2022, Oben Electric is further expected to launch these new vehicles to offer the same level of reliability and performance as equivalent to their internal combustion engine (ICE) counterparts.What does the future look like?One of the notable features of Oben Electric's new vehicles will be the  LFP battery which is proven to be one of the most efficient battery technologies of the time. LFP batteries are particularly well-suited for India's challenging climatic conditions. This technology ensures that Oben Electric's vehicles can deliver reliable performance and longevity, even in extreme temperatures. Moreover, the vehicle will also feature superior heat resistance making the rides more durable and with an extended lifespan.  Underlining the company’s commitment to the future, Ms. Madhumita Agrawal, Founder and CEO of Oben Electric said,  “As we celebrate World EV Day, it is important to recognize the immense potential of India's electric vehicle market. With the right products and infrastructure, we can facilitate the transition from ICE to EVs with ease. At Oben Electric, we are committed to building electric vehicles that not only meet the performance expectations of our consumers but also address the demand for sustainable, cost -effective and locally manufactured solutions. We believe that with our new models, we are taking a major step toward unlocking the full potential of the EV market and making electric mobility accessible to all”,  In addition, the company's strategic expansion plans include the opening of over 60 new showrooms across 12+ major cities by the end of the year. This aggressive expansion is expected to enhance accessibility and ensure a seamless ownership experience for Oben Electric customers through a robust network of after-sales support and service centres.About Oben Electric:Oben Electric is one of the companies at the forefront of the Indian electric two-wheeler market which is transforming the world of commuting. The company was established in August 2020 and is based in Bengaluru with expertise in designing, developing and manufacturing high-performance electric motorcycles and their critical components all under one roof.Taking advantage of a passionate team of technologists who have been working on electric vehicle R&D for over 25 Years, Oben Electric stands for 'Design in India for the World.' An exemplary approach by which innovative electric motorcycles are produced not only for Indians but also for possible self-sustaining markets worldwide.Oben Electric has always led from the front as it spearheads multiple pioneering transformations concerning how people use electric two-wheelers within India. Among others, this firm first embraced advanced battery chemistry such as LFP (Lithium Iron Phosphate) on its electric motorcycles. Compared with most other conventional battery chemistries, these offer enhanced safety attributes longer ranges and cleaner operations making them suitable for diverse climatic conditions and rough terrains across India.Further demonstrating their commitment to research and development are well over two dozen patents owned by its innovative technology alongside the EV components manufacturing division of Oben Electric.
